metric_definitions.bytes_per_token: normalized UTF-8 bytes / emitted tokens; higher is more compression
metric_definitions.tokens_per_unicode_character: emitted tokens / normalized Python Unicode characters
metric_definitions.token_length_bytes: exact decoded source-byte contribution per token; fallback contributes one byte, not its spelling length
metric_definitions.vocabulary_utilization_percent: 100 * distinct observed IDs / (vocabulary size - four controls); byte IDs remain eligible
metric_definitions.rare_token_percent: 100 * emissions with pooled diagnostic-training count <= rare_threshold / emissions; not full tokenizer-training rarity when capped
metric_definitions.cross_word_merge_rate_percent: 100 * observed SuperBPE pair applications / initial adjacent token boundaries, summed within documents; other engines have zero cross-word application events
metric_definitions.cross_word_token_percent: 100 * emitted tokens intersecting at least two whitespace-delimited non-whitespace fields / emissions; not morphological word segmentation
metric_definitions.fragmentation: maximal whitespace (str.isspace) or Unicode category P runs; tokens_per_run is token-byte-span intersections / runs; split_run_percent is 100 * runs touched by >1 token / runs
metric_definitions.aggregation: pool counts, vocabulary-ID unions and length histograms before ratios/quantiles; never average stratum rates
metric_definitions.nulls: undefined zero-denominator ratios and absent validation coverage are null, never zero evidence
